sentences.en: For many conditions, including colitis, eczema or psoriasis, we recommend drinking magnetized water.

sentences.en: Alternatively, for reasons that remain unclear, E. histolytica trophozoites can invade the colonic epithelium, causing amoebic colitis.

sentences.en: In cases of suspected or verified antibiotic-associated colitis, discontinuation of linezolid may be warranted.

sentences.en: A young man with colitis described his illness as " a yellow omelet on a round white plate with red ketchup " .
